name: directus-extension-image-url-display
description: Directus display: renders a text field's value as an image thumbnail in list/detail views - lets editors see a book's cover before filling in required fields like title/language. Value is used directly as the src, unless a URL Prefix option is configured (for fields that store a bare key, e.g. catalog.media_assets.s3_key, rather than a full URL).
